title: Fair Housing Act — Statute profile
subject: Fair Housing Act
summary: Fair Housing Act is a statute of United States enacted in 1968, in the area of housing. Bans discrimination in the sale, rental, and financing of housing. It is formally cited as Title VIII, Civil Rights Act of 1968.

facts.cite: Title VIII, Civil Rights Act of 1968

key_points: Citation: Title VIII, Civil Rights Act of 1968.
Core effect: Bans discrimination in the sale, rental, and financing of housing.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
